baseline_models.focus_anchor: The three ق و ل occurrences at words 1, 4, and 8 stage a claim, its correction, and an authorized replacement, while ء م ن and س ل م supply the competing state labels.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah separates an utterance from the state it names. It does not silence the speakers after rejecting their self-ascription; it gives them language that truthfully names an achieved outward relation without pretending that settled trust is already inwardly present.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech supplies the audible channel and makes the three occurrences function as claim, correction, and replacement formula.
Speech as belief or doctrine supplies the category the first formula overclaims and the corrective formula deliberately narrows.
Trust that reassures the heart supplies the inward condition against which the spoken claim is measured.
Delivering or relinquishing a thing supplies a real yielded relation that can be named without equating it with inward trust.

changed_reading.before: The speakers make a false claim and are simply denied believer status.
changed_reading.after: The ayah performs controlled relabeling: their speech outruns the state it names, so they are assigned truthful language for a real but different relation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction 'faith has not yet entered your hearts' joins temporal delay, inward motion, and the heart as destination.
baseline_models.mechanism: Faith is modeled as a settled condition crossing an interior threshold, not as a synonym for pronunciation. The not-yet construction leaves movement live: outward yielding may exist before inward security reaches the core.

activation_trace.role: Calm security in the heart supplies the stable state whose arrival is still pending.
Literal ingress supplies the threshold vector and turns the contrast into a process with an outside and an inside.
The inward or secret domain supplies the hidden depth that public wording cannot itself certify.
The pure core of a thing supplies the destination as the person's center rather than a surface identity.

changed_reading.before: The denial marks a fixed binary between believers and nonbelievers.
changed_reading.after: The denial diagnoses an uncrossed but temporally open threshold: submission is present, while settled trust has not yet reached the inner core.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: After correcting the faith claim, the ayah immediately gives a conditional route through obedience and guarantees that nothing of their works will be diminished.
baseline_models.mechanism: Status diagnosis and action accounting are distinct ledgers. Present lack of inward faith does not erase agency; obedience remains available, intended work remains countable, and forgiveness and mercy keep the correction from becoming expulsion.

activation_trace.role: Compliance and obedience supply the operative condition that remains open after the status correction.
Messenger and message supply the mediated relation in which obedience becomes concrete rather than generic.
The wage or return of work supplies the accounting register protected by the conditional promise.
A known, reportable thing supplies item-level completeness to the promise that no work entry is lost.
Forgiving while shielding from consequence supplies protection around an audience whose claim has just been corrected.
Mercy and tenderness supply the relational tone that keeps diagnosis joined to an available future.

changed_reading.before: Being denied inward faith makes the speakers' works religiously irrelevant.
changed_reading.after: The ayah decouples present status from the work ledger: obedience is still consequential, no earned item is shaved away, and correction remains under mercy.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier, misconduct toward the messenger can make works collapse without the actors noticing; here, obedience to God and His messenger guarantees no diminution. The two clauses form opposed trajectories in one relational ledger.

activation_trace.role: Obedient compliance supplies the focus-side posture that protects the work account.
Work as wage or return supplies the focus-side ledger in which nothing is withheld.
Falling and collapse supply the inverse motion by which works can be lost through a damaged relation.
The return of work identifies the same account as vulnerable in the earlier warning and protected in the focus.
Fine awareness supplies the missing perception, making the earlier loss dangerously imperceptible.

structural_cues: 49:2's 'your works collapse while you do not perceive' is the negative mirror of 49:14's obedience and no-diminution conditional.
The branchless focus verb at word 20 contributes only the structural no-diminution pole; no branch identity is assigned to it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposite work outcomes around conduct toward the messenger; I infer a reversible relational ledger. A live alternative is that the two clauses are separate warnings and promises rather than a designed symmetry.

changed_reading.before: The obedience clause is a generic promise of reward.
changed_reading.after: It is the restorative inverse of an earlier hidden collapse: obedient posture protects works from the erosion that disordered speech can cause.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context presents hearts as tested and refined for protective consciousness. Faith's entry in the focus can therefore be read not as depositing a label but as an interior quality becoming exposed, purified, and capable of restraint.

activation_trace.role: The hidden interior supplies the chamber whose quality cannot be read directly from a public claim.
The pure core supplies the focus destination as material whose condition matters.
Testing that reveals what is in the heart supplies an evidentiary process for distinguishing claim from interior condition.
Purification after testing supplies transformation, not merely inspection, as a possible account of inward formation.
The core repeats as the object of testing and links the earlier assay directly to the focus destination.
Placing the self in protection supplies the behavioral capacity produced by a tested interior.

structural_cues: 49:3 explicitly joins divine testing, hearts, protective consciousness, forgiveness, and reward before 49:14 denies completed inward entry.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies tested hearts and a not-yet-entered faith; I infer that entry names a quality-forming assay rather than mere placement. The alternative is that testing describes a distinct exemplary group without defining the focus group's process.

changed_reading.before: Faith is an inward object that is either present or absent.
changed_reading.after: Faith's presence is an assayed condition of the core, revealed and refined into restraint; the focus group has not yet undergone or manifested that interior stabilization.

context_deltas.mechanism: The callers stand behind enclosed rooms and are told to wait for the messenger to come out; the focus reverses the vector, requiring faith to go in. External demand and inward reception become competing threshold postures.

activation_trace.role: Ingress into an interior supplies the focus-side inward vector.
The inner core supplies the enclosure that must receive rather than summon faith.
Being covered and placed behind supplies the callers' exterior position relative to concealed authority.
An enclosed place supplies the architectural boundary across which the callers project their demand.
Passage to the outside supplies the delayed outward vector that the callers are required to await.

structural_cues: The ordered scene moves from calling behind rooms in 49:4 to waiting for an exit in 49:5, while 49:14 uses the opposite verb of entry into hearts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enclosure, behindness, exit, and later entry; I map that architecture onto receptive versus demanding epistemic posture. The live alternative is that the room scene remains only a literal etiquette episode with no intended inward reversal.

changed_reading.before: The group merely lacks an internal belief state.
changed_reading.after: Their deficit can also be pictured directionally: they demand that authority come outward on their terms, while faith requires an opposite movement into their own guarded interior.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier report protocol refuses to let transmitted speech authorize action until its meaning is exposed. The focus applies an analogous discipline to self-description: 'we believe' is audible evidence, but not self-authenticating evidence of a hidden heart.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech supplies the self-report that is heard and then corrected rather than accepted as proof.
Heart-reassuring trust supplies the hidden state that a report about oneself cannot establish by wording alone.
A delivered report supplies the epistemic object that must be processed rather than passively repeated.
Exposing meaning through speech or sign supplies verification as a move from wording toward disclosed reality.
Absence of knowledge supplies the danger of treating an unverified verbal surface as sufficient.
Regret over a missed matter supplies the downstream cost of acting on speech before reality is clear.

structural_cues: 49:6 has a report-verification-consequence chain; 49:14 has a quoted identity report followed immediately by correction and a more exact formula.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a general report discipline and a corrected self-report; I infer an analogous evidentiary rule for identity claims. The alternative is that 49:6 concerns only news from an unreliable carrier and does not govern self-ascription.

changed_reading.before: The correction simply accuses the speakers of lying.
changed_reading.after: The correction refuses to let an utterance certify the hidden condition it reports; the problem is an evidentiary mismatch even before motive is decided.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context gives positive content to faith's entry: God makes faith beloved and beautifies it within hearts. Entry is therefore an affective reordering of attraction and aversion, not merely the arrival of a proposition.

activation_trace.role: Ingress supplies the focus's incomplete movement into the interior.
Reassuring trust supplies the inward state whose felt texture the context discloses.
Love that adheres to the heart supplies durable attraction as one effect of faith's inward presence.
Making beauty manifest supplies a changed valuation by which faith becomes attractive from within.
The core supplies the shared location where love and adornment specify what completed entry would alter.

structural_cues: 49:7 repeats faith and hearts but adds causative love, adornment, and aversion; 49:14 repeats the pair under a not-yet entry construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the same faith-heart coupling plus causative affect; I infer that 49:7 describes the qualitative result missing in 49:14. A live alternative is that love and adornment are gifts associated with faith but not a definition of entry itself.

changed_reading.before: Faith's entry is an invisible propositional switch.
changed_reading.after: Faith enters by remodeling desire and valuation in the core; the focus group can pronounce belief before that affective installation has occurred.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context calls fighting parties believers and brothers while requiring repair and restraint. Against that social field, 'we submitted' can name genuine entry into public peace and accountable community even while settled inward trust remains incomplete.

activation_trace.role: Peace and pacification against war supply submission with a concrete public function rather than making it an empty rejected label.
Inwardly reassuring trust supplies the distinct interior axis that public pacification does not automatically complete.
Combat between two parties supplies the public rupture that communal ordering must contain.
Removing mutual estrangement supplies the repair process by which public peace is restored.
Aggressive transgression supplies serious moral disorder that can coexist with the context's believer designation.
Brotherhood and kinship supply durable communal inclusion across conflict and repair.

structural_cues: 49:9-10 retain the predicates 'believers' and 'brothers' across fighting, transgression, and reconciliation; 49:14 distinguishes that social field from completed inward faith.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies war, peacemaking, brotherhood, and a focus branch of peace for س ل م; I infer a public-juridical function for 'we submitted.' The alternative is a narrower sense of surrender without full communal inclusion.

changed_reading.before: 'Say: we submitted' is only a humiliating downgrade from a false faith claim.
changed_reading.after: The replacement formula recognizes a real peace-bearing public status that can coexist with inward incompletion and future moral accountability.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding ayah makes peoples and tribes coordinates for mutual recognition while locating rank in protective consciousness known by God. Thus 'the Bedouins' identifies the speakers socially; it does not make ancestry the cause of their inward deficit.

activation_trace.role: Arabs, Arabic, and Bedouins supply the focus's social group designation as the object needing interpretive control.
Heart-reassuring trust supplies the inward criterion that cannot be inherited from a group name.
A people gathering tribes supplies collective identity as an organizing social scale.
A group whose members face one another supplies tribe as relational arrangement rather than spiritual essence.
Recognition by trace or mark supplies the stated purpose of social differentiation.
Praiseworthy honor supplies the rank explicitly detached from lineage and attached to another criterion.
Knowledge of the inward reality supplies divine access to the criterion that group labels cannot expose.

structural_cues: 49:13's universal origin, social differentiation, and rank criterion immediately precede 49:14's named group and disputed self-classification.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies group categories for recognition and an inwardly adjudicated rank; I infer that 49:14's group noun is situational, not causal essence. The alternative is that the focus still generalizes about a historically specific subset's current conduct.

changed_reading.before: The ayah says that Bedouins as an ethnic or social type do not believe.
changed_reading.after: It corrects this group's present claim without turning lineage or way of life into the cause of unbelief; social name and inward rank remain separate axes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah operationalizes inward faith as stability beyond doubt followed by costly exertion of resources and self. Truth is the continuity of claim, settled center, and enacted cost, so the focus correction diagnoses a missing chain rather than a missing password.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech supplies the claim whose truth must extend beyond pronunciation.
Settled security supplies the stable center that contrasts with later agitation by doubt.
Agitated doubt supplies the instability excluded from the context's believer model.
Expenditure of full capacity under hardship supplies the costly outward continuation of inward settlement.
The very self supplies the maximal stake by which the claim moves beyond cheap speech.
Making promise and action real supplies truth as enacted correspondence rather than verbal correctness alone.

structural_cues: 49:15 follows the focus with a restrictive believer definition ordered as faith, no doubt, costly exertion, and finally truthfulness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered criteria and a final truth label; I infer that they expose the continuity missing behind 49:14's claim. The alternative is that 49:15 offers an ideal exemplar rather than a diagnostic test for the preceding speakers.

changed_reading.before: Faith versus submission is a wholly invisible inner distinction.
changed_reading.after: Inward settlement has a temporal and costly signature: stable trust continues into expenditure of property and self, allowing speech to become truthful through enacted continuity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing context rejects attempts to inform God about one's religion, then joins knowledge of the unseen to sight of works. The focus distinction is grounded in asymmetrical access: hidden center and visible action are integrated in divine knowledge, not certified by human wording.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech supplies the limited public evidence whose reach the closing context constrains.
Heart and inner faculty supply the hidden domain about which the claim is made.
Disclosure of a thing to the knower supplies the asymmetry behind the rebuke to those who would inform God.
Belief joined to entrusting supplies religion as the very inward relation the speakers presume to report upward.
What is concealed from eyes supplies the hidden side of the focus distinction.
Insight of the heart supplies perception deep enough to join inner condition with outward evidence.
Intentional action supplies the visible side that divine sight reads together with the unseen.

structural_cues: 49:16's question about teaching God one's religion and 49:18's unseen-plus-works closure surround the favor reversal of 49:17 after the focus claim.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine knowledge of religion and unseen reality together with sight of works; I infer this as the epistemic basis of the focus correction. The alternative is that 49:16 primarily rebukes boasting rather than explaining how status is known.

changed_reading.before: The correction is a social judgment based on suspicious reading of the speakers.
changed_reading.after: It is an epistemic judgment unavailable from surface speech alone; humans cannot self-certify or police the hidden state with the access attributed to God.

context_deltas.mechanism: The speakers convert submission into leverage by recounting it as a favor to the messenger. The context reverses donor and recipient: guidance toward faith is a gentle gift from God, so the focus's corrected formula is true only when it is not treated as owned capital.

activation_trace.role: Relinquishing or handing over supplies the valid focus description that the speakers later turn into a claim on another.
Reassuring inward trust supplies the destination that cannot be manufactured as a boast.
Burdening a recipient by recounting a favor supplies the social pressure in the human claim and the target of the reversal.
Handing oneself over supplies the same real act now exposed as something that cannot invoice the messenger.
A gently dispatched gift supplies faithward guidance as received beneficence rather than self-produced credit.
Heart-settling trust supplies the named endpoint toward which the gift directs them.
Truthful speech supplies the explicit condition that keeps the guidance claim open rather than automatically confirmed.

structural_cues: 49:17 repeats human favor-claim, prohibition, and divine favor around a sharp 'rather' reversal, while repeating submission and faith from 49:14.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a threefold favor inversion and guidance as gift; I infer that the corrected label can itself become corrupt when monetized as leverage. The alternative is that the verse teaches gratitude without changing the semantic force of 'we submitted.'

changed_reading.before: 'We submitted' is either an empty lesser label or a credential the speakers possess.
changed_reading.after: It names a real yielding but not an owned claim on the messenger; movement from that status toward faith is received guidance, and the direction of indebtedness is reversed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it connects the womb branch of ر ح م to faith's entry into the heart. It remains focus-anchored through the explicit ingress, core, covering, and final Merciful description, but it should be rendered only as a material metaphor for protected formation, never as a lexical claim that the ayah literally says gestation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Faith has not yet entered the hearts, and the ayah closes with forgiveness and the Merciful.

activation_trace.role: Ingress supplies the movement into a protected interior on which the gestational analogy depends.
The core supplies an inner site of formation rather than a public badge.
Protective covering supplies containment around an unfinished inward process.
The womb supplies the branch-distant image of sheltered growth that makes 'not yet' developmental rather than final.

changed_reading.before: The not-yet clause only excludes the speakers from a completed category.
changed_reading.after: Under a contained gestational image, it can also picture an inward life not yet formed but held within forgiveness and mercy as a possible protected development.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because it activates the non-dominant ق و ل to ق ل ل mapping and places its quantitative images beside the focus's no-diminution construction. It remains anchored in the three speech occurrences and the work account, but downstream prose should label it split-root wordplay about measure and burden, not the morphology or primary sense of ق و ل.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: An overlarge self-description is replaced by a narrower one, after which the ayah promises that no item of obedient work will be diminished.

activation_trace.role: Scarcity and smallness supply quantitative pressure to right-size a claim that exceeds the achieved state.
Taking up and bearing a load supplies the image of a statement able to carry only the evidential weight actually achieved.
Work as recompensed labor supplies the account whose true weight is protected after the verbal claim is reduced to scale.
A discrete known thing supplies exact itemization to the counter-promise that no real work is made small.

changed_reading.before: The replacement formula merely lowers the speakers' rank.
changed_reading.after: The formula right-sizes speech so it bears only achieved reality, while the paired promise insists that truthful obedient work itself will not be shortchanged.

strongest_changes: The focus moved from a binary exclusion to controlled self-description across distinct public, inward, and action-accounting axes.
Earlier work-collapse and the focus's no-diminution promise formed a reversible ledger organized by posture toward the messenger.
Faith's entry acquired process content: assay, affective revaluation, costly continuity, and divine rather than verbal certification.
Submission remained a real public peace-bearing status but lost its use as leverage when 49:17 reversed the direction of favor.
The adjacent peoples-and-tribes frame blocked an ethnic essentialization of the named Bedouin speakers.
summary.what_was_special: The unusual density comes from one corrected sentence being reactivated by opposite vectors and ledgers across the window: outside versus inside, collapse versus preservation, self-report versus divine knowledge, conflict versus peace, and claimed favor versus received guidance. These mechanisms coexist without reducing Islam to false faith or treating inward faith as inaccessible to enacted evidence.
remaining_uncertainties: The architectural reversal from rooms and exit to faith entering hearts is coherent but may be an exploratory sequence effect rather than an intended linkage.
The public-juridical force of submission is strongly activated by peace and brotherhood branches, but the focus itself does not spell out a legal status.
The branchless focus verb at word 20 supports only the negative accounting structure; its lexical branch contribution cannot be assessed from this packet.
The gestational and split-root quantitative readings should remain visibly qualified material analogies, not lexical substitutions.
